capabilities.label: Basins, entropy, boundary dimension and uncertainty
Static Frenkel-Kontorova kink relaxation and Peierls-Nabarro barrier
capabilities.note: Static discrete-kink energy/relaxation and pinning barrier tools; not a general driven depinning solver.

capabilities.label: Diatomic lattice bands and group velocity
Run, replay, recording and step controls
Trajectory CSV, figure and experiment export
Legacy tab query and browser history
Stable public scripting namespace and legacy aliases
Legacy workspace storage and import shape
Open-loop cart-pole expansion model
capabilities.note: Existing model applies constant open-loop force; a feedback controller is not claimed.

capabilities.label: Chimera-seeded nonlocal Kuramoto exploration
capabilities.note: Reuses Kuramoto dynamics and chimera diagnostics, not an independent engine.

capabilities.label: Huygens two-clock phase reduction
capabilities.note: Phase reduction only; no mechanical escapement/contact model.

capabilities.label: Pendulum lattice / harmonic Frenkel-Kontorova limit
capabilities.note: Existing nearest-neighbour pendulum network and harmonic dispersion; not a claim of a separate general FK depinning solver.
